banner.title: tdarr
banner.tagline: Runs the Tdarr server and a GPU worker that transcodes the NAS library on an Intel B70 over VA-API.

explainer.title: Server coordinates, one GPU worker transcodes

steps.title: Server
steps.text: The Tdarr server serves the web UI on 8265 and runs the flows. Its database and flow state sit on the tdarr-config claim.
steps.scene: a server rack with a glowing control panel

steps.title: Worker
steps.text: One tdarr-node pod requests devic.es/b70-vaapi, the card on talos-3, and runs two GPU transcode jobs and one CPU job.
steps.scene: a graphics card with two glowing transcode lanes

steps.title: Transcode
steps.text: Workers read the NAS media share and write intermediates to the tdarr-temp RWX claim, so large files stay off the node disk.
steps.scene: a film reel feeding a conveyor of glowing frames

steps.title: Remote
steps.text: tdarr-node-lb exposes port 8266 on the LAN, so a GPU node outside the cluster joins the same server.
steps.scene: a remote workstation linked to a server by a bright cable

steps.title: Keep
steps.text: kopiur snapshots the tdarr-config claim to R2 each day. The temp claim is scratch and is not backed up.
steps.scene: snapshot cards flowing into a cloud bucket
